name: Sigil
tagline: Encrypt your text and files right from your phone
description:
Sigil brings a set of everyday cryptography tools to your phone in one clean, modern app. Encrypt and decrypt text messages, protect sensitive notes, and work with common cryptographic tasks, all through a simple Material 3 interface.

It's built for anyone who wants an easy way to keep private text private, without needing to understand the cryptography happening under the hood.
